info.title: spot-kilmerviolin API
info.description: Request-validation spec for Cloudflare API Shield Schema Validation. Mirrors the route files under src/pages/api/v1 and src/pages/submit; tests/openapi-drift.test.ts keeps the operation list in sync. Record schemas are shape-level (extra properties allowed); the server's own validators remain authoritative.

get.summary: List contact responses or export CSV

patch.summary: Mark contact responses read or unread

requestBody.description: file and alt are expected; not validated by API Shield

put.summary: Replace a file or its metadata

requestBody.description: file and/or alt; not validated by API Shield

enroll.description: If present, create a contributor record to bypass the self-enrollment flow

confer.description: Confer the acting identity's conferrable permissions

post.summary: Purge cache and trigger a rebuild

QueryFull.name: full
QueryFull.description: Return full records instead of IDs (files: FileMeta records instead of keys)

QueryNames.name: names
QueryNames.description: With full (works list) or on a single work, resolve composer and contributor names

QueryBulk.name: bulk
QueryBulk.description: Required when the body carries more than one item

QueryDryRun.name: dry_run
QueryDryRun.description: Validate every item and return a per-row report without writing anything

QueryElevate.name: elevate
QueryElevate.description: Admin only: bypass the safe-property check or apply the admin override

QueryDirectContrib.name: direct_contrib
QueryDirectContrib.description: The caller is managing contributors directly; the editor is not auto-added to contrib_addl

QueryAll.name: all
QueryAll.description: Admin only: list every issued token instead of only the caller's own

QueryAutodeactivation.name: autodeactivation
QueryAutodeactivation.description: Deactivate the associated contributor record when removing the user (default true)

QueryBatch.name: batch
QueryBatch.description: Run multiple commands as one atomic batch (default true)
